column3: I'm not sure what I should be doing next.
The doctor seemed pretty upset about what happened. Where did he go?
I need another hint, what should be doing?
Bergmann said the doctor was looking for you, did he say where he went?
Head back to Lady Unterwald's quarters, you'll find the doctor there!
I need a hint about one of the safe mechanisms.
Which one did you have in mind?
I need a hint about the combination lock.
If I had to remember a six-digit number, I'd pick something personal, so there'd be no way to forget it.
I need another hint about the combination lock.
If it's a six-digit number, chances are it's a date. Most people would pick something memorable, like a birthday.
Lady Unterwald's medical records would likely contain her date of birth, if you can get your hands on them.
I need a hint about the voice lock.
You'd need a recording of Lady Unterwald, but that may be difficult.
I need another hint about the voice lock.
Didn't another passenger have a way to record voices?
What happened to them?
Don had a recording device, right? Maybe he dropped it during the brawl.
That recording device isn't much good without a blank tape, I'm sure one will turn up sooner or later.
High-tech problems often have high-tech solutions, have another look around.
That recording device isn't much good without a blank tape, know anybody that might have a spare?
Diana has a bunch of gadgets, perhaps she has a blank reel you could borrow?
You're all set, you just need a recording of Lady Unterwald's voice. Be ready with that device of yours.
Listen out for Lady Unterwald's voice. It might be closer than you think.
What about the automated message from Lady Unterwald when you use the phone? Have you tried recording that?
Actually, I wanted to ask about something else.
Alright! Ask away!
How do I get behind that curtain?
You'll need to perform the secret handshake, but it all happens so fast!
I need another hint to get behind that curtain!
Is there a way to capture that handshake? You'd better be quick about it!
There's a passenger on the train who captures things at speed. Maybe they can help?
I recorded the handshake, now what?
Someone aboard that train knows what goes on behind the curtain. Ask around!
I need another hint about these sketches!
You'll need someone familiar with the handshake to identify those sketches.
The doctor might be willing to assist you if you can convince him!
The doctor told me the phrases, now what?
Head back to the curtain and show that guy who's boss!
How can I get information out of Mr Masson?
It seems like he's either too drunk, or you're too sober.
I need another hint to get Mr Masson talking.
What's Mr Masson been drinking? Perhaps you can ask around.
Try to learn what Mr Masson is drinking, have you asked the waiter?
What's Mr Masson been drinking? Perhaps you need to get on his level.
You could recreate what Mr Masson is drinking, have you asked the barman?
I need to make my Bud-Lite more powerful.
Maybe you can combine it with something else to create a more potent version?
I need another hint to make my Bud-Lite more powerful!
Maybe you can combine it with something else, was there anything potent in your room?
I'd combine it with something else, do you have anything potent on you?
Can you combine the mouthwash in your room with the Bud-Lite?
Try adding some of that mouthwash you have, that'd kick it up a notch!
I need a mixing container for the Rosebud.
You might need something large and unconventional to mix those ingredients in.
I need another hint about finding the container.
Someone on board might have a suitable goblet, if you can distract them for long enough.
I bet Arista's hearing horn could hold a lot of liquid! Try creating a diversion, and don't get caught in the act!
I have a potential mixing container, but I'm unsure of the next move.
You might need to modify the container to hold liquid.
I need another hint about using the container.
You should find something to plug up the end of that container.
The bartender has a corking device that might do the trick, perhaps you could ask to borrow it?
That corking device you have might do the trick, give it a go!
I've made the Rosebud, what should I do?
Stop stalling for time, you need to drink up, kid!
How do I get into the luggage room?
The luggage room? You'll probably need to use the right item to get in there.
I need another hint about accessing the luggage room.
Perhaps you already hold the key to that question?
You have a set of keys, have you tried those on the door?
I need help opening this briefcase.
I doubt you'll manage to unlock it, some brute-force might be the better option.
I need another hint about opening the briefcase.
A passenger might be able to help. Although sometimes two heads are better than one!
Those twins will argue over anything, I'd hate for that briefcase to come between them.
I've been given this blank napkin, what gives?
Listen, kid, nobody's handing out blank napkins. I'd look into figuring out what's on there.
I need another hint about the napkin.
Someone on board might know how to decode hidden messages, have you asked around?
The Order Of Idle Hands might know something about decoding messages, I'd start there.
I need that guide book, but Jared won't let me at it!
Perhaps you could trade the book for another.
I need another hint about getting the book.
He'd notice if you stole it, perhaps you can swap the book for another.
You'll need to swap the guide book with Don's book of poems. Just make sure Jared isn't looking!
I need to access the kitchen, but the chefs won't let me in!
Well, you ain't getting past them. I'd wait 'em out, I'm sure they'll be done soon.
I need another hint about the kitchen.
Personally, I'd pursue some other lines of enquiry, and try again later.
Just wait 'em out, no use trying to brute force your way in!
How do I capture that thieving mouse?
How does that mouse move around the train? Maybe you can limit its movements.
I need another hint about catching that mouse.
There's a fair number of holes for that mouse to slip through, you'll need to find a way to narrow those down.
You'll need to block off any escape routes, do you have anything that can plug a hole?
You've blocked off the escape routes, but you'll need some bait to lure it out.
I need another hint about the mouse.
All that thievery must be hungry work. With the right food, you could bait it out.
No mouse can resist the sweet allure of cheese. I bet there's some already stored away in the kitchen pantry.
How can I capture that thieving mouse?
You probably don't want to grab it with your bare hands. Find some protection!
You probably don't want to grab it with your bare hands. Do you have anything that can provide you with protection?
You shouldn't use your bare hands. You should secure yourself a pair of gloves.
You shouldn't use your bare hands. Do you have any gloves to hand?
Check the kitchen for oven gloves, they should protect against any biting or scratching.
Those oven gloves should protect against any biting or scratching.
I've managed to capture the mouse, what's next?
Have you told the chefs you've solved their mouse problem? I'm sure they'd be relieved.
I've decoded the napkin, what should I do now?
That number's gotta mean something. Have you taken another look around?
Is it possible that the number matches a room number?
Heating the napkin revealed a room number, right?
Try sliding that napkin under the door.
How do I get into Herman's room?
Herman's room? Using the right item will be key to getting in there!
I need another hint about accessing Herman's room.
I've located the will, but I can't reach it!
I don't think you'll be able to reach it with your bare hands!
I need another hint about getting the will.
You might be able to fashion something to give you better reach.
You can fashion a rudimentary hook with Lady Unterwald's walking stick and a bit of metal wire.
You need something to secure that metal hook in place, got anything on you?
Don't you have surgical tape on you? Use that to reinforce that hook you've made.
